goblin001.name: Goblin
goblin001.description: A small, smelly goblin wielding a crooked dagger.

goblin_emissary001.name: Goblin Emissary
goblin_emissary001.description: A slightly cleaner goblin, clutching a tattered scroll. It looks nervous.

dialogue.persuade_success: Oh, alright then. Boss said to watch out for a shiny rock near the old stump. Maybe you find?
dialogue.persuade_fail: Go away, stupid! Or I call guards!

wild_dog001.name: Wild Dog
wild_dog001.description: A scruffy, wary-looking canine with matted fur and sharp teeth. It eyes you cautiously.

dialogue.on_tame_success: The wild dog cautiously approaches, sniffs your hand, and then lets out a small whimper, wagging its tail slightly.
dialogue.on_tame_fail: The wild dog snarls and snaps at you before backing away, unconvinced by your efforts.
dialogue.on_engage: The wild dog barks fiercely and lunges!
